messages:
Marta: quick sync — we need a fast pass on web copy for the launch: hosted api, dedicated, private. focus: one hero, 2nd-level claim, and webinar hook. also plan 3 launch posts. who can take which piece?
Liam: I can do the hosted hero + technical microcopy. want to test hero: 'Production-first inference' vs 'Predictable, low-latency inference' — which leans better for devs?
Nina: I prefer 'Production-first inference' for headline, but have alternative body: 'Same API. Multiple deployment modes. Predictable latency and cost.' keeps flow.
Sylvia: For posts we should stitch a benchmark narrative: 1) latency benchmark vs cloud endpoints, 2) cost-per-1000-token story, 3) enterprise isolation/Private case study. each gets a social image + CTA to sign up for webinar.
Marta: agree. timeline: copy draft by EOD Thu, design by Mon, webinar landing + registration by next Wed.
Ashok: I'll prepare benchmarking numbers and a small chart. ping me which metric matrix you want (p50 latency, 99th, tokens/sec, $/1000).
Nina: @Ashok include both hosted and dedicated cost curves. for private just include qualitative note + compliance callout.
Liam: inbound routing question — do we funnel all landing signups into a single form or split by mode? suggestion: single form with hidden model selection, then route: hosted -> SDR self-serve flow, dedicated -> AE touch, private -> enterprise AE + legal ops.
Sylvia: yes, split at routing layer. we can add quick radio buttons: 'Building a prototype' | 'Predictable production' | 'Enterprise/compliance' to improve lead scoring.
Marta: good. @copy-bot can you generate two micro-variations for hero + webhook sentence for webinar invite?
copy-bot: generated variants:
- Variant A hero: "Production‑first inference for real apps." sub: "Hosted API, Dedicated pools, Private deployment — one consistent API." CTA: "See benchmarks & join the webinar"
- Variant B hero: "Ship reliable, low‑latency LLM features." sub: "Optimize cost and uptime across hosted, reserved, and private deployments." CTA: "Register: Launch webinar"
Nina: Variant A feels tighter. I'll write two short lead paragraphs for hosted vs dedicated.
Liam: For microcopy, add small note under Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed latency' and under Private: 'VPC & on‑prem options, audit logs & KMS support.'
Ashok: For webinar hooks, propose a short agenda line: '1) Benchmarks & economics 2) Deployment patterns 3) Q&A + migration checklist' — that'll help co-marketing with Solutions.
Sylvia: scheduling: propose 45min slot midday — aim for a Tue or Wed to maximize attendance. also plan three promotional posts: announcement, benchmark highlight, register reminder.
Marta: owners: Nina = landing copy + webinar page, Liam = hosted microcopy + tech notes, Sylvia = social posts + cadence, Ashok = benchmark assets. delivery: copy drafts by Thu 5pm PST.
Liam: quick routing snippet suggestion to hand to eng (in plain text):
```
form -> parse selection
if selection == "Hosted": tag=hosted, route_queue=sd-portal
if selection == "Dedicated": tag=dedicated, route_queue=ae-dedicated
if selection == "Private": tag=enterprise, route_queue=ae-enterprise
```
Nina: I'll add the radio copy and a short privacy line.
copy-bot: staging preview published at https://staging.redwood.ai/landing/launch-copy (draft-3).
Marta: great — sync tomorrow 10am to review drafts. please drop final hero + primary CTA in thread by then. :thumbsup:
Liam: noted.
Sylvia: noted.
Ashok: I'll drop the benchmark CSV and a 1-slide chart before EOD.
Nina: uploading copy fragments now.
Marta: thanks team — small lean pass, big impact.
copy-bot: automated note — this thread will be archived to "marketing/campaigns/launch" after 30 days.
